title: 브라운필드의 코끼리: AI로 개인은 빨라졌는데, 조직은 왜 그대로인가
content:
AI transformation in brownfield enterprises faces significant challenges beyond technology, primarily rooted in rigid organizational structures and defensive professional identities. Even when AI accelerates internal workflows, the process stalls at organizational boundaries due to cross-team dependencies and bureaucratic bottlenecks.

  • Resistance arises when employees perceive roles and authority as core components of their identity.
  • Efficiency gains are neutralized by traditional approval processes and conflicting team backlogs.
  • Successful AI integration requires structural agility to transcend departmental silos.
